data.long_meaning: The name Chote is derived from the Hindi language and translates to 'little' or 'small'. This name is often used for young children or babies, signifying their small size and innocence. In Hindu mythology, the god Ganesha is referred to as Chote Ganesha, meaning 'Little Ganesha'. The name Chote carries the meaning “Little, Small” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chote usually hope their child will grow to embody little, small and live with faith, good character and purpose.
